exam: 111年公務人員高等考試三級考試暨普通考試
subject: 船舶輔機概要

essays.text: 性能良好之冷凍機必須搭配適當的冷媒，請說明十項冷媒的選擇條件。（20 分）
請說明如何能讓鍋爐達到熱能的充分利用，以提升效率之三種方法。（20 分）
請詳述十項輔機配管應注意之事項。（20 分）

請將下列英文譯成中文。（20 分）Water was the original hydraulic fluid, however, it is not a good lubricant sinceit promotes rusting and other forms of corrosion. Hydraulic oils may bestraight mineral or special additive oils. Properties of these, enhanced byadditives, include oxidation, stability, film strength, rust prevention, foamresistance and anti-wear characteristics to enable the fluid to stand up to thehigher operating temperatures and pressures of modern systems.
